lxc_64bbfabc1adf2546.text: Basketball is easy to follow when we look at the court, points, its start, and famous people.

lxc_c3eab250a354f95d.text: Each idea comes in a small step.

lxc_a8c39fedfcbba5df.text: Basketball for kids is a team game with a ball and a hoop.

lxc_bac4ea859fc0fd1d.text: Each team has five players on the court.

lxc_2c4fcfb3837a8a89.text: The court is the place where they play.

lxc_3837bae98990ccb1.text: They try to shoot the ball through a hoop.

lxc_6b1a08eef26c436d.text: The hoop is a basket on a backboard.

lxc_22ff00cf574bbb78.text: The backboard is the board behind the basket.

lxc_58cfacd6c3bfa1c3.text: A made shot can give a team points.

lxc_cf928c371a42b658.text: A field goal is usually worth two points.

lxc_ad529b648bb0f01c.text: A shot from behind the three-point line is different.

lxc_1ee24e0bd7de014f.text: It is worth three points when it goes through the hoop.

lxc_e776d515c94ffbd9.text: The three-point line is the line on the court where a made shot is worth three points.

lxc_7ead2e8dceb30d77.text: Basketball began with a gym teacher.

lxc_b8b50cf053dceb8c.text: James Naismith was the gym teacher who made basketball in 1891.

lxc_458b08de1d2c115c.text: The first game was played on December 21 that year.

lxc_88287985138a33d0.text: Springfield is the city in Massachusetts where basketball was first played.

lxc_d4f2c66884eb6d17.text: Basketball has a clear starting year, day, and place.

lxc_1472aed4f665c1b6.text: One big name in basketball is the National Basketball Association.

lxc_8d0b4b79df567cce.text: It is a big basketball league.

lxc_275dbebbc1433449.text: People often use the short name NBA.

lxc_bdbef7b1552c9d35.text: NBA means the National Basketball Association.

lxc_0ddb9fd7305402ae.text: When you see NBA, you now know that it names the big basketball league.

lxc_a542568c37a1dc77.text: This short name is also important in the story of a famous player.

lxc_7f79396799c580dd.text: Michael Jordan is a famous basketball player.

lxc_fee76577eb623ca3.text: His full name is Michael Jeffrey Jordan.

lxc_f7074b039b545fb1.text: MJ is made from his initials.

lxc_bbae5e432c4b5dbb.text: He played 15 seasons in the NBA between 1984 and 2003.

lxc_7a78a791507dfaac.text: People also gave him other nicknames.

lxc_4061078da194d190.text: He won six NBA championships with the Chicago Bulls.

lxc_458c2067228240a3.text: The Chicago Bulls are the basketball team he played for when he won those championships.

lxc_a1bcd59c8a1d5ee2.text: In the 1995–96 season, the team had 72 regular-season wins.

lxc_877e248eda49a47b.text: This was a record at that time.

lxc_522413b26b28a40a.text: They also called him His Airness.

lxc_88b0d341ba85fcf7.text: Both names were nicknames for him.
